notes: Goldens are derived per-frame FNV-1a state hashes, not game data; the inputs they were generated from are pinned by the checksums in corpus.json.
Regenerate only from a c-reference/* tag with run_corpus.py --generate; never hand-edit.
Debug builds run the stability gate but are not compared against these goldens (FP results may differ by optimization level, ADR-010).
Mod-tier entries (ad, copper, alkaline, quoth) had no local data at generation time; their goldens are absent and their corpus entries skip until the data is added and goldens are regenerated.
